description: CRIT-205's passThreshold requires: 'state.json's proofObligations array, after this sprint's Phase 3/5, shows every one of the 19 listed PROP IDs as status:proved (with a citation to the REAL orchestrator function's own source, never a mocked-caller fixture alone) or, for any exception, a Phase-5 contract note stating the specific reason it could not be closed this sprint ... FAIL if any of the 19 is left pending with no stated reason.' Independently re-read state.json's proofObligations array (66 entries) this round: every one of the 19 PROP IDs the contract's own 'Deferred-obligation disposition' section commits to closing this sprint (PROP-106a/PROP-106b/PROP-106n/PROP-106e/PROP-106f/PROP-106g/PROP-106h/PROP-106k/PROP-106l/PROP-106o/PROP-106p/PROP-106i/PROP-105h/PROP-114c/PROP-112a/PROP-108c/PROP-108d/PROP-109e/PROP-109g) still carries status:'skipped' and required:false -- NONE were flipped to status:'proved', and none carries a citation to lending-orchestrator.mjs or to any sprint-2 test. This directly contradicts the contract's own text ('All 19 of contracts/sprint-1.md's own deferred obligations are targeted for closure this sprint ... none require a real, live token spend to prove'). The gap is NOT that the underlying behavior is untested -- the actual test suite (lending-orchestrator.test.mjs, 30 new tests, all passing) DOES appear to exercise most of these properties in substance (e.g. the PROP-115d staggered-race test structurally closes PROP-106a/e/f/g/h/k/l/n/o/p's own 'wired into a live issuance attempt' residual scope per verification-architecture.md line 520-521; PROP-116c/PROP-116d close PROP-108d/PROP-109e/PROP-109g; the step-3/step-6 kill-switch tests close PROP-105h/PROP-114c; the step-2 co-location test closes PROP-112a). The gap is that this evidence was never propagated into state.json's own bookkeeping -- exactly the failure mode this project's own CLAUDE.md warns against ('SPEC本文への手書き追記だけで進捗を語り、コマンドを呼ばない/state.jsonが進まないのはVerifyをやったことにならない'). Per CRIT-205's own literal passThreshold text, this is a FAIL: the 19 obligations are left at 'skipped', not 'proved', and no Phase-5 contract note anywhere states a specific reason each one could not be closed this sprint (the contract's own text asserts the OPPOSITE -- that all 19 WOULD be closed).

evidence.snippet: e.g. {"id": "PROP-019", "tier": 2, "required": false, "status": "skipped", "artifact": "specs/verification-architecture.md#PROP-106a", "beadId": "BEAD-030"} -- and identically 'skipped'/'required:false' for the other 18 PROP-106*/PROP-108c/PROP-108d/PROP-109e/PROP-109g/PROP-112a/PROP-105h/PROP-114c entries; none has a 'citation' or 'note' field pointing at lending-orchestrator.mjs or lending-orchestrator.test.mjs.

crossCheck.note: The contract's own prose commits to closing all 19 this sprint via structural/unit/integration proof against the REAL orchestrator functions, and CRIT-205's passThreshold explicitly requires the state.json flip to status:proved (or an explicit exception note) as the actual gate condition -- not merely that tests exist on disk. The test suite passing (119/119, verified independently this round via `cd ~/anicca && node --test skills/economy/lending/lib/__tests__/*.test.mjs`) is necessary but not sufficient evidence for this criterion; the bookkeeping step was never performed.

resolutionRecommendation: For each of the 19 PROP IDs, either (a) flip state.json's status to 'proved' with a citation to the specific lending-orchestrator.test.mjs test name(s) that close it (most already exist and pass -- this is largely a bookkeeping update, not new code), or (b) if a specific PROP genuinely cannot be closed via the current test suite, add an explicit Phase-5 contract note stating why and leave it appropriately flagged (not silently 'skipped'). Then re-run vcsdd-harden/Phase 5 to regenerate the verification-report reflecting the true closure count.
